thread.text:
Today: Logged as Upper A, pain(R) 6/10, but none of the prescribed slots appear — no incline bench, chest fly, reverse fly, lateral raise, or one-handed triceps pull. Instead the session ran Deadlift, Pull Up, Seated Row (Cable), Straight Arm Pulldown, Triceps Dip, Single Arm Cable Chest Fly, Bicep Curl (Barbell) — closer to the Upper B template from 09-24. Pull-ups held slot 2 as prescribed: +8kg × 8, 8, 8. Triceps Dip matched its usual bodyweight × 12, 12, 12.

Trend: Deadlift added a new top set, 70kg × 5, 6, after 40 × 8, 60 × 8 — heavier than the 60kg × 6, 6 ceiling on 09-24. Pull-ups at +8kg (24 total) trade a touch of volume for load against +5kg × 10, 8, 8 (26 total) on 09-28 — reasonable given the jump. Bicep Curl (Barbell) hit 8, 8, 8 today; 09-17 was 8, 8, 7, so this is the first clean top-range session, one more like it earns the next increment. Seated Row (Cable) and Single Arm Cable Chest Fly are new names with no history to compare against.

Right lat: 6/10 is the highest reading in the whole log — squarely amber. Today's pulling used Seated Row (Cable) rather than the iso-lateral right/left rows, so the explicit row protocol has nothing to apply to. Treat the 6/10 itself as the flag regardless of which row variant triggered it, and let the physio weigh in before the next iso-lateral row session.

Next session: Upper C, Sat 3 Oct. Carry 26kg DB press, 18kg chest-supported row (trial 3 of 4, no gate — lighten if the right side talks), 14kg hammer curl, all needing 12 across the board to progress.

Question: Was today a deliberate swap to Upper B content, or did Thursday and Monday get crossed this week?
